text:
maya: Quick check — who owns the weekstart rollout (morning wave) Monday? Need clear smoke owners and rollback leads. Ping if you have conflicts.

Tom: I have the morning slot but need someone for smoke and rollback standby. Can take deploy lead.

sasha: I can own smoke checks (20 min after deploy). Will do health dashboard + trace check. :white_check_mark:

liam: I'll be rollback lead. I'll be on-call 09:30–11:30 PST. If we see error rate >1% roll back. I'll coordinate.

olivia: FYI staging passed perf #s. ETA for main deploy slot 09:00 PST. Would like a quick CR approval at head.

jordan: I can do CR + merge at 08:45. Please tag me. @tom @sasha

maya: Awesome. Putting it in the rollout plan. Also adding fallback model variant in case of tokenization regressions — if latency spikes >200ms p50 fallback to smaller model.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @tom at 09:00 PST to cluster-prod-uswest. Canary 5% for 10min, then 50% for 10min, full 100% after manual proceed.

sasha: Smoke checklist:
```
- /health endpoint OK
- p50 latency < 220ms
- error-rate < 0.5% for 5m
- no 5xx in logs
- sampling sanity prompt tests (3)
```

Tom: I'll notify here when canary starts. If anything looks off ping @liam and I'll abort via rollback button. :thumbsup:

liam: I'll be available. Also have quick rollback playbook:
```
1) hit rollback endpoint
2) switch routing to prev model
3) re-run smoke
4) escalate to oncall if persists
```

maya: Thanks all — I updated the release board with owners. @olivia can you drop the final build tag here when ready? If no objections, this is green.

olivia: Pushed tag: v2026.04.07-mw1. Dropping smoke sample logs in #incidents if needed.

Tom: starting canary in ~5m. will post status.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> ok (no anomalies in first 2m). Monitoring.

sasha: Canary smoke passed: all checks ✅. Proceeding to 50% hold.

Tom: 50% hold started. Watching metrics.

deploy-bot: 50% hold complete -> no anomalies. Awaiting manual proceed.

Tom: Proceeding to 100%. Done. Rollout complete. :sparkles:

maya: Great job team. Postmortem not needed. Short note in release notes about fallback config. Thanks!
